objective: Try genuinely different AI learning targets rather than another classifier on the same target-before-stop label. Freeze direct normalized payoff, multi-horizon excursion, model classes, folds, event conversion and evaluation gates before computing outcomes.
prohibited: threshold, side, month, feature, exit or horizon rescue
portfolio construction from rejected or exploratory candidates
prospective Shadow without explicit user authorization and a frozen contract
frequency_reporting: Every event and completed-trade count must include evaluation calendar months, count per calendar month, active months and monthly min/median/max.
evidence_ceiling: Any new historical result is exploratory until genuinely new future data is observed.
